TEXT: [FI] And so, the days and months drifted by...
[FI] Since then, I behaved as the very model of a gallant otaku to gain favor from Saori's parents.
[FI] Before we knew it, they were saying things like, "His future's looking bright, this one's a keeper!"
[FI] And then today, despite Saori and I still being in high school, we were finally at our beautiful marriage ceremony.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You're nervous, aren't you, Kyousuke-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course! It's a marriage after all, a marriage.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Oh no, it's not something to be worked up over.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] This is just for the sake of silencing my fussy parents. You could call it playing make-believe.
[FI] You're being pretty harsh to your parents, don't you think?!
[FI] "For the sake of my parents..."  Just where did the exemplary Saori go?!
[FI] Well, in her case, not holding anything back about her parents may be a good thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It's a ceremony merely for appearances, because you haven't been entered into our family registry yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] So, don't tense your shoulders so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*... You sure have it nice, you're not nervous at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But... I am nervous...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] There's no way I wouldn't be...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I think I have experienced a few more things than most people.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But wearing a wedding dress and being a bride... this is my first time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-san, you just keep taking all my first times...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Don't say something so easily misunderstood.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It was a compliment.①

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But, honestly speaking...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] This kind of pounding in my heart is a first in my life...
[FI] Saori looking embarrassed, fidgeted while looking downward.
[FI] When a man sees a girl behaving like this...
[FI] It makes him fall for her. Or... it makes him want to bully her...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Haha, I took yet another one of your first times, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh...? A-Ah!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...You said to stop, yet here you are telling me the same thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] From now on, we have to be considerate of each other.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I may not be reliable yet, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I will take responsibility and make you happy!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes!
[FI] And so, Saori and I got married.
[FI] ...What about the height difference?
[FI] ...I'd be lying if I said I didn't care...
[FI] But, not enough to worry over it because...
[FI] My wife is the cutest in the whole world!
